subject: Execution timeline & MSA/DPA/order form — sequencing questions
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Park <natalie@medlumen.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Execution timeline & MSA/DPA/order form — sequencing questions

Hi Natalie,

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — great to see alignment on scope and the pilot targets. To get the procurement track moving and avoid surprises during legal review, we want to confirm sequencing between the MSA, DPA, and order form in your org. A few quick questions so we can draft a MAP and realistic close timeline: 

- Who owns the signature path at MedLumen (legal vs procurement vs finance)? Is it one approver or multiple?
- Are there mandated review steps (security questionnaire, privacy office signoff) that must complete before countersignature?
- Do you require a named SLA appendix in the order form or will a standard order form with reference to SLA suffice for pilot?
- Target go-live date for the pilot and any immovable milestones (e.g., clinical review board, product committee)?

If you can confirm by EOD Wednesday 9/20, we’ll build a 6-week MAP with proposed gating (legal redline window, procurement PO issuance, DocuSign execution, onboarding kickoff). I’ll attach a draft MAP + suggested owner matrix for your team to review.

Attachments: proposed-map.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior GTM Strategy, Redwood Inference

On Mon, 18 Sep 2028 at 09:55 Natalie Park <natalie@medlumen.com> wrote:
> Karthik — thanks for the overview earlier. I’m looping Ben (procurement) on the details below.
>
> — Natalie
From: Natalie Park <natalie@medlumen.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@medlumen.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Sep 2028 11:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Execution timeline & MSA/DPA/order form — sequencing questions

Hi Karthik — quick answers below and happy to fill in more if helpful: 

- Signature path: final signature comes from VP Finance (Ben), procurement handles PO + initial commercial review. Legal reviews redlines but is not the final signer.
- Mandated steps: Security team needs a completed questionnaire and SOC2 evidence available before production keys are handed off. Privacy wants to review the DPA but will not block signature if redlines are standard.
- SLA: For pilot we accept the standard order form with a 99.9% availability target in the service description; if pilot expands we’ll discuss a separately signed SLA appendix.
- Pilot target: internal pilot kickoff 11/06/2028; clinical review meeting on 10/25 is a hard milestone.

I’ll coordinate with Ben to confirm availability for a quick alignment call with your legal team.

Thanks,
Natalie Park
Director, Clinical Integrations — MedLumen
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Sep 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: Execution timeline & MSA/DPA/order form — sequencing questions

Karthik / Marissa — I reviewed the MedLumen template they shared on the call. Quick notes (attached: MedLumen_MSA_highlights.pdf + redline-comments.docx):

- Commercial/Order form: confirm that the PO will reference the MSA effective date (we should ask procurement to issue PO only after countersignature to avoid term confusion).
- Data processing: they flagged a data residency clause for EU customers; for now MedLumen confirms US-only pilot but privacy wants the DPA versioning called out in the MAP.
- Indemnity/limitation: standard customer redlines likely. I suggest we propose a 10-business-day negotiation window for the MSA redline review in the MAP and a 3-business-day turnaround for order form finalization after commercial terms are locked.
- Security evidence: request SOC2 Type II report and an attestation to retention policies before keys.

I’m attaching the highlights and inline comments — these will be our negotiation anchors. If Ben is issuing PO, we should include him in the MAP owners as the 'procurement approver' and list Laura (Legal) for contract redlines, Marissa (AE) for commercial terms, and Karthik (GTM) for timeline ownership.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MedLumen_MSA_highlights.pdf (stub), redline-comments.docx (stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Park <natalie@medlumen.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@medlumen.com>

Date: Tue, 25 Sep 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Execution timeline & MSA/DPA/order form — sequencing questions

Thanks everyone — summarizing next steps and proposed MAP so we have a single source of truth: 

1) MAP owners and high-level timeline (6 weeks to pilot kickoff; assumes standard redline cadence):
   - Week 0 (9/25): Confirm owners and information requests (Natalie to confirm Ben as procurement approver).
   - Week 1 (9/25–10/02): Legal redline window (10 business days) — Laura leads; Redwood will provide a clean MSA and suggested redline responses by 9/27.
   - Week 2 (10/03–10/09): Order form commercial signoff — Marissa leads; procurement to issue PO only after countersignature per Laura's recommendation.
   - Week 3 (10/10–10/16): Security review & SOC2 evidence exchange — MedLumen security to confirm questionnaire return date.
   - Week 4 (10/17–10/23): Final sign-off and DocuSign execution window.
   - Week 6 (11/06): Pilot kickoff (hard clinical review milestone 10/25).

2) Open items for MedLumen:
   - Confirm PO policy (Ben) — can PO be issued pre-signature or do you require countersign?
   - Share SOC2 PDF and retention attestation by 10/09.
   - Confirm who will own the SLA appendix if pilot expands.

3) Attachments we’ll circulate after this thread: proposed-map.xlsx (action owners + gantt), clean MSA for initial redline, and a DocuSign envelope set up for the order form + MSA bundle.

Natalie / Ben — can you confirm Ben’s role and whether procurement will issue PO pre- or post-signature? If we get those answers this week we’ll lock the MAP and send invites for a 30-minute alignment call.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior GTM Strategy, Redwood Inference
